note: Identified-rig simulator GIF runs for Report.md section 7. One deterministic 15 s hanging-start episode each, seed 0, standard simulator, configs/my_rig.json. Regenerated 2026-11-09 on the submitting machine from the committed code (scripts/report_sim_eval.py --check-seed0 reproduces these numbers); the first version, made on another machine, differed by up to 0.3 deg in the final-10 s error.
